old: More alkyl groups give more hyperconjugation, so 3° (I) > 2° (II) > 1° (III). The vinyl cation (IV) puts the charge on an sp carbon, which holds electrons tightly (50% s character), and the empty p orbital lies in the plane of the π bond, so the π bond cannot donate into it. Vinyl cations are even less stable than primary cations. I > II > III > IV.
